title: connections item (Connection)
description: Real-time (SSE) connection registry: Connection(connectionId, firmId, userId, expiresAt) (DISENO S7 (b)(c)). DISENO 'expiresAt' is stored as the TTL attribute 'ttl'.
$comment: Table connections (per cell). Partition key only: PK = CONN#<connectionId>. GSI1: GSI1PK = FIRM#<firmId> (no sort key in DISENO). AP-G1: Query GSI1 (connections of a firm). TTL attribute ttl (= Connection.expiresAt; session duration, DISENO 5.1).

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter session duration (DISENO 5.1) (no value fixed in the docs). Equals Connection.expiresAt.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Constant ACTIVE; the item expires by TTL at the end of the session. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
